lines.beaver_en: Hello. Are you here to fill out the registration form?
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my name and date of birth here.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. What is your nationality?
lines.en: I'm American. I'm an overseas Korean who grew up in the US.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, then where are your parents from?
lines.en: Both of them came from Korea.

lines.beaver_en: Could you also check the gender box?
lines.en: Sure, I marked female for gender.

lines.beaver_en: Yes, that's right. Please write your address too.
lines.learner: 번지가 하도 길어서 휴대폰을 보고 쓸게요.
lines.en: The lot number is so long, I'll check my phone.
lines.roman: beonjiga hado gireoseo hyudaeponeul bogo sseulgeyo.

lines.beaver: 천천히 하세요. 이사 오신 지 얼마 안 되셨어요?
lines.beaver_en: Take your time. Did you move here recently?
lines.beaver_roman: cheoncheonhi haseyo. isa osin ji eolma an doesyeosseoyo?
lines.en: Yes, I moved here not long ago.

lines.beaver_en: If you have a nickname, could you write it down?
That's fun. Why do they call you that?
lines.learner: 제가 너무 조용해서 옛날 배우 같대요.
lines.en: I'm so quiet they say I'm like an old-time actress.
lines.roman: jega neomu joyonghaeseo yennal baeu gatdaeyo.

lines.learner: 한국에서 일을 구했어요. 부모님이 아주 기뻐하세요.
lines.en: I found a job in Korea. My parents are very happy.
lines.roman: hangugeseo ireul guhaesseoyo. bumonimi aju gippeohaseyo.

lines.beaver_en: That's great. Your form is all done. Thank you.
lines.en: Thank you. Have a good day!
